title: Practice 2: Holding on, settling in, coming round

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does о- add in опра́виться (“to recover, to pick up”)?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists опра́виться under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to sit down (comfortably), to take a seat
to settle down, to get settled
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: усе́сться — to sit down (comfortably), to take a seat; уле́чься — to lie down; устро́иться — to settle down, to get settled; опра́виться — to recover, to pick up.

exercises.q: What does о- add in опо́мниться (“to come to one's senses, to collect oneself”)?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists опо́мниться under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does о- add in оду́маться (“to think better of it, to change one's mind”)?
options: turning into something, giving it particular properties
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists оду́маться under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in влюби́ть (“to cause (someone) to fall in love, to enamor”)?
options: giving or acquiring a status or state
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists влюби́ть under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in влюби́ться (“to fall in love (to come to have feelings of love)”)?
options: the manner of an action, given by the base word
giving or acquiring a status or state
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists влюби́ться under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in воплоти́ть (“to incarnate, to embody, to personify”)?
options: giving or acquiring a status or state
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists воплоти́ть under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does о- add in обогати́ть (“to enrich, to make rich”)?
options: spreading the action over the whole object, its whole surface or volume
turning into something, giving it particular properties
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists обогати́ть under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to come to one's senses, to collect oneself
to think better of it, to change one's mind
to cause (someone) to fall in love, to enamor
to fall in love (to come to have feelings of love)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: опо́мниться — to come to one's senses, to collect oneself; оду́маться — to think better of it, to change one's mind; влюби́ть — to cause (someone) to fall in love, to enamor; влюби́ться — to fall in love (to come to have feelings of love).
